about_the_game:
Introduction

Styx:Final Shores is a narrative-driven adventure game that blends exploration, recruitment, and base-building. You will captain an ark sailing on the River Styx, encountering diverse souls—from legendary heroes to nameless spirits—and stand with them against the unknown of death. The choices you make on this journey will illuminate their stories until they reach the void.

Background

The Final Shores—where souls forget all. You captain a lone ark sailing the endless waters of the Styx. Along the way, great figures from history and nameless souls board your vessel: a defeated general speaks of unconquered ambitions, an obscure poet murmurs unfinished verses. Their stories weave a tapestry of death. And you, on this irreversible journey toward an unknown destination—how will you inscribe this traceless voyage?

Developer's Notes

"Death is a journey, not an end. May you find your own echo on this final voyage."

**→ Add to Wishlist and set sail on the River of Oblivion!**

short_description: On the vast expanse of the Styx, you captain an ark through the mist of death. Heroic spirits from history and wandering souls laden with regrets emerge upon the river, recounting their tales. You will recruit these souls as companions, sailing together toward the void's end.
